So there are two objects? Left object color4/1 at rows5-7 cols3-6:

A solid 5x4 rectangle.

According to rule: left object move to left edge (start col0) preserving vertical position. right object move to right edge (end col18) preserving vertical position. Grid width 19. But careful: The left object includes row5 and right object also row5. They were separated; after shifting, left at cols0-3, right at cols15-18. Fine. Need output same 11x19 zeros except:

row7 cols0-3 = [4,4,1,4]

Right object rows1-5 cols15-18 = [5,5,5,5] each.

Check if any other interpretation: Could objects maybe grouped by connected components? Left object color 4 and 1 connected? At row5 c3=4,c4=4,c5=1,c6=1; row7 c5=1. The 1s adjacent to 4?
